title: Confounded Face Emoji 😖 Meaning: Frustrated and Cringing
description: The 😖 confounded face emoji scrunches its eyes and twists its mouth. It means frustration, cringe, disgust or pain. See how it compares with 😣 and 😫.
summary: The 😖 confounded face has tightly scrunched eyes and a wavy, crumpled mouth. It means the sender is overwhelmed by a bad feeling they can barely hold in: frustration, embarrassment, physical discomfort or disgust. Think of the face people make when biting a lemon or remembering something mortifying.
meaning: “Confounded” is an old-fashioned word, and few people choose this emoji for its dictionary sense of being baffled. They choose it for the look: a face clenched so hard the mouth has gone squiggly. That expression fits moments when the body reacts before the mind does, such as a sour taste, a stubbed toe or a wave of secondhand embarrassment.

Frustration is the most common use. “I've restarted the router four times 😖” shows someone at the end of their patience but not exploding. The emoji turns the irritation inward, which distinguishes it from the angry faces. The sender is suffering, not blaming anyone. It is the face of gritted teeth and a long breath through the nose, not of a raised voice.

It also expresses cringing. Watching a friend's disastrous karaoke, rereading an old diary or recalling something said at a party can all earn a 😖. A smaller group uses it for intense positive feelings, like squealing over something unbearably cute or being flustered by a crush, in the way people scrunch up their faces when a feeling is too strong. Context makes that reading obvious when it applies.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It usually closes a complaint: tangled plans, a slow computer, a headache that will not quit. It says “this is getting to me” with a little humor. In reply to someone's awkward story, it means you are wincing along with them. It rarely stands for serious distress.

contexts.label: About food and the body
contexts.body: People use it for sour candy, bitter medicine, cramps, sore muscles after the gym and the first sip of bad coffee. Here it is nearly a drawing of the real expression. It is milder than 🤢, which implies nausea; 😖 only says something is unpleasant.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: It marks cringe content and relatable frustration: assembly instructions that make no sense, autocorrect failures, an awkward wave at a stranger. In fan communities it sometimes expresses being overwhelmed by a favorite character or performer, a scrunched-face squeal in emoji form.

examples.text: This math problem has taken me an hour 😖
examples.meaning: Frustrated and stuck, and close to giving up.

examples.text: I just remembered what I said at the party 😖
These sour gummies are no joke 😖
examples.meaning: Showing the puckered face that sour candy causes.

examples.text: Leg day was yesterday and I can't use the stairs 😖
examples.meaning: Aching, with a touch of self-mockery.

examples.text: He smiled at me and I forgot how to talk 😖
examples.meaning: Flustered and overwhelmed by a crush.

examples.text: The wifi dropped right before I hit save 😖
examples.meaning: Exasperated by bad luck with technology.

combos.meaning: Cringing and facepalming over an embarrassing mistake.
Fed up with a computer or with work on a screen.

confusedWith.difference: 😣 also squeezes its eyes shut, but its mouth is a simple frown, suggesting someone straining to push through. The squiggly mouth on 😖 looks more helpless: overwhelmed, not determined.
😫 has an open, wailing mouth and means fed up or exhausted in a loud way. 😖 keeps its mouth clamped shut, holding the feeling in.
🥴 has uneven eyes and a wobbly mouth for being drunk, dazed or smitten. The wavy mouth is similar, but 😖 has both eyes scrunched and reads as discomfort.

avoid: Do not use it to react to someone's cooking, gift or work unless you intend to say it is bad.
It is too slight for serious pain or illness; describe those in words.
Avoid it when you mean you are confused, since most readers will see frustration or disgust.
design: A yellow face with eyes squeezed into angled lines, like a greater-than and less-than sign facing each other, and a mouth drawn as a tight zigzag or wavy line. Vendors agree on the scrunched eyes; the mouth varies from a sharp W shape to a gentler squiggle. The overall effect is a face crumpling under pressure.

faqs.a: Most often that the sender is frustrated, cringing or physically uncomfortable. It shows a bad feeling being held in. Occasionally it means being overwhelmed by something cute or by a crush.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 😖 and 😣?
faqs.a: Look at the mouth. 😣 has a plain frown and suggests enduring something with effort. 😖 has a crumpled, wavy mouth and suggests being overcome by frustration, disgust or embarrassment.
Despite the name, not usually. “Confounded” can mean bewildered, but people generally use this emoji for frustration and discomfort. For confusion, 😕 or 🤔 are clearer choices.
Rarely. Some people use it when a crush leaves them flustered, in the sense of squirming with feeling. Without that context it is simply a frustrated or pained face.
